item.title: Director of elder services to leave post in June
item.description: LYNN — Meegan Simpson-Best, the city’s director of elder services who runs the Lynn Senior Center, will be leaving her position when her contract expires in June. “It has been a phenomenal experience,” Simpson-Best said. “We’ve watched the senior center move forward and grow in a lot of ways.
